name: doordash_ads-mcp
description: DoorDash Ads (ads): me, list_campaigns, update_budget, pause_resume. Every tool maps to a documented

platform_mcp_doordash_ads_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DOORDASH_ADS_API_KEY
platform_mcp_doordash_ads_api_key.description: DoorDash Ads API key; the Ads API reference's security scheme 'Ads API Key Authentication' reads: 'We will be using stateful token based API keys to authenticate clients, passed in the Authorization header as Bearer {API_KEY}' (https://developer.doordash.com/en-US/redocusaurus/plugin-redoc-11.yaml). Issued to onboarded DoorDash Ads (CPG) advertisers and partners.

platform_mcp_doordash_ads_campaign_type.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DOORDASH_ADS_CAMPAIGN_TYPE
platform_mcp_doordash_ads_campaign_type.description: Campaign type path segment of every campaign call: 'sp' (Sponsored Products) or 'sb' (Sponsored Brand).

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint is documented; the probe lists one campaign (GET /ads/api/v1/{campaignType}/campaigns?count=1), which verifies the API key.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /ads/api/v1/{campaignType}/campaigns?startIndex&count (0-indexed offset). Each CampaignResponse has campaignId, name, status, statusDescription, budget {daily, lifetime: {unitAmount (cents), currency, displayString, decimalPlaces}, pacingStrategy}, startDate/endDate ('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'). The budget stays in raw.budget because it is in cents. account_id and status are not sent (the API key selects the advertiser; no status filter is documented).

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: PUT /ads/api/v1/{campaignType}/campaigns {campaignId, budget: {daily: {unitAmount}}} with daily_budget converted to cents; a partial update (the existing pacingStrategy is preserved). This spends money. currency is ignored (the advertiser's currency applies).

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: PUT /ads/api/v1/{campaignType}/campaigns {campaignId, status: ACTIVE|PAUSED} (StatusWrite enum ACTIVE, PAUSED, ENDED). Resuming restarts spend.
